title: AURA project settings
description: Rules and hooks for AURA's agents in this folder (.aura/settings.json is shared; .aura/settings.local.json is yours).

defaultMode.description: The permission mode a developer starts in. The admin can still restrict modes.

ask.description: Always ask, even if a built-in rule would allow it.

afterEdit.description: Commands run after each file change; {file} is the changed file.

beforeCommit.description: Commands that must pass before a git commit runs.

rules.description: Bash(npm run e2e), Bash(npm run e2e:*), Edit(src/**), Read(.env*)
